$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-228 S1 (§5.3) — provider-id reference maps for the AFL.com.au JSON APIs (source_key 'afl_api'). Every entry here is transcribed from data/sources/AFLWebsite/AFLGamesSamples/00-season-matches.raw.json (2026) and .../historical-samples/<year>/00-season-matches.raw.json (2022-2025), verified by anchored Grep over the raw single-line JSON, never guessed. Team identities validate against data/reference/clubs.json 'hist' (never by name, per §6.2). Venue identities are DELIBERATELY INCOMPLETE (see 'venues' below); an unmapped venue's match is never a run-level HALT (§6.2), so shipping this file incomplete is safe by the runbook's own design, but as of AFLDB-ISSUE-244 I244-F003 (2026-09-21) an unmapped provider venue on a planned (afl_api-owned or new) match is a per-unit REFUSAL, not a silent NULL: settle-afl-api.ts counts it (venueProviderUnmapped/venueUnmapped), opens an 'afl_api_venue_unmapped' data_issues finding, and withholds the match itself from auto-apply until the map (or the venues row it names) is corrected, at which point the same match self-heals on the next settle of the same immutable snapshot.

teams.$comment: CD_T<id> -> clubs.legacy_club_hist, with the exact raw name/abbreviation/nickname AFL.com.au publishes so §6.2's drift check has something to compare against. All 18 rows verified against every team object in the 2026 season-matches sample (218 matches, 436 team slots). Six raw names differ from legacy_club_hist (Adelaide Crows, Geelong Cats, Gold Coast SUNS, GWS GIANTS, Sydney Swans, West Coast Eagles) -- expected, per §2.1.

venues.$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-244 I244-F003 (2026-09-21, two continuations): a READ-ONLY `SELECT id, slug, canonical_name, legacy_name, city, state, first_season, last_season FROM venues` against afldb_test (transaction_read_only=on, no row altered) proved TWO things this file previously could only guess at: (1) every one of the 52 canonical venues has a non-NULL legacy_name -- the §7 worry that legacy_name might be NULL for some real venues does not hold; (2) legacy_name equals canonical_name VERBATIM for every venue except three historically-abbreviated ones (M.C.G., S.C.G., W.A.C.A.). Continuation 1 turned nine of the 2026 season's 17 distinct CD_V provider venues into deterministic matches: five where src/search/nl/vocab.ts's VENUE_NICKNAMES (tracked repository evidence, not fuzzy similarity) already ties a commercial/colloquial provider name to a canonical_name the DB query confirms shares its legacy_name (Gabba, Docklands/Marvel Stadium, Kardinia Park/GMHBA Stadium, Perth Stadium/Optus Stadium, York Park/UTAS Stadium), and four where the provider's own raw venue name is IDENTICAL, character-for-character, to a legacy_name (Barossa Park, Adelaide Oval, Norwood Oval, Hands Oval). Continuation 2 (this pass) resolved the remaining six via authoritative public naming-rights-history evidence (AFL.com.au venue pages, Wikipedia, official venue/club sites -- not textual pattern matching, and never inferred from locality alone; see afldb-issue244.md §37.12): TIO Stadium = Marrara Stadium under naming rights, confirmed the same facility as canonical 'Marrara Oval' (~12,500 capacity, 'largest stadium in the Northern Territory', distinct from the separate 'Marrara Oval 2'); TIO Traeger Park = Traeger Park under naming rights, confirmed the same Alice Springs facility; Corroboree Group Oval Manuka = a GWS-announced three-year naming-rights rebrand of Manuka Oval itself (GIANTS official site); Ninja Stadium = Bellerive Oval under naming rights (AFL.com.au, official Ninja Stadium address at 15 Derwent Street, Bellerive); People First Stadium = the same Carrara ground continuously renamed (Carrara Stadium 1987 -> Metricon Stadium 2011 -> Heritage Bank Stadium 2023 -> People First Stadium 2024, AFL.com.au/Austadiums); ENGIE Stadium = Sydney Showground Stadium, the GWS Giants' continuous home venue since 2012 under successive sponsor names (Skoda -> Spotless -> Giants Stadium -> ENGIE), confirmed textually and by capacity/purpose (~23,500, AFL/cricket) as distinct from both Stadium Australia/Accor Stadium (~80,500, a separate venue in the same Sydney Olympic Park precinct) and the Sydney Cricket Ground (different suburb) -- the only one of the three same-city canonical candidates the evidence uniquely selects. All 17 of the 2026 season's distinct CD_V provider venues are now mapped; none was guessed.

seasons.$comment: year -> AFL API compSeason numeric id and CD_S providerId, verified from the top-level compSeason object of each season's 00-season-matches.raw.json.
